title: The Legend of von Neumann (1973) [pdf]
why_read: A classic historical essay on John von Neumann's extraordinary mathematical and computing legacy, enjoyable for anyone interested in computing history.
analysis: This is a 1973 essay/retrospective on John von Neumann, one of the founders of modern computing architecture and a towering figure in math, physics, and economics. It's not a technical paper but a biographical and historical piece, valuable for understanding the intellectual roots of concepts like the stored-program computer and game theory. Worth reading for context rather than new technical content, since it recycles well-known anecdotes about his legendary intellect.
